Senses.Explanation: Literally, to raise or present in full. Yunmen Wenyan supplies the decisive contrast: seeing no single form is only half-presentation, and even then one must know the occasion of full presentation (不見一色，始是半提……更須知有全提時節). Shengyin Chongkai pairs presentation across past and present with the ancestral master's true command (祖師正令，今古全提). Juelang Dasheng joins the flower at Vulture Peak and snow at Shaoshi with separate transmission personally shown and the true command fully presented (靈山花發，親示別傳；少室雪寒，全提正令). Yuanwu Keqin raises the command in full (據令全提) and publicly asks how it can be unfolded. Liao'an Qingyu says that the entrustment at Vulture Peak is precisely here and tells the assembly to take up one fully presented saying (一句全提，大家薦取); Shending Yunwai Ze similarly says that if one can present it whole with bare hands, ease is assured (若能赤手全提，管取逍遙自在). Zen bends the ordinary sense of completeness toward teaching-seat language: a saying, command, or lineage entrustment is brought forward without remainder and submitted to the assembly.
Senses.Note: The corpus has 1,834 exact occurrences in 308 allowlisted texts. Seven exact witnesses cover the explicit half/full contrast, command formulas, one-saying use, and direct public questions. Command, saying, and entrustment are objects of the same act of full presentation, not distinct referents.

Occurrences.Kwic: 不見一色，始是半提。直得如此，更須知有全提時節。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Continued Essentials from the Ancient Honored Ones (續古尊宿語要), Yunmen Wenyan contrasts half-presentation with the occasion of full presentation.
In the Complete Lamp Collection, volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), Shengyin Chongkai pairs full presentation across past and present with the ancestral master's true command.

Occurrences.Kwic: 靈山花發，親示別傳；少室雪寒，全提正令
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Juelang Dasheng (天界覺浪盛禪師語錄), Juelang Dasheng joins the Vulture Peak flower and Shaoshi snow with separate transmission and the true command fully presented.
In the Record of Ancestral Teaching Essentials (列祖提綱錄), Yuanwu Keqin says that when one saying is fully presented, the thousand differences gather together.

Occurrences.Kwic: 據令全提。且道。如何展演。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄), Yuanwu Keqin raises the command in full and asks the assembly how it can be unfolded.

Occurrences.Kwic: 靈山付囑，正在於斯，一句全提，大家薦取
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Liao'an Qingyu (了菴清欲禪師語錄), Liao'an Qingyu locates Vulture Peak's entrustment here and tells the assembly to take up one fully presented saying.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若能赤手全提，管取逍遙自在。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Recorded Sayings of Shending Yunwai Ze (神鼎雲外澤禪師語錄), Shending Yunwai Ze says that one who can present it whole with bare hands will be at ease.
